boundary_coverage: Public verify signature, default 8192, name, qualname, docstring and exports retained
Token-first and digest-first imports, explicit setup and compiler-free fallback
Prepared policy rejects booleans, integer subclasses, nonpositive and noninteger limits
No per-request optional backend probing or later public-function rewiring
Callbacks can replace codecs, MAC and comparison and trigger GC during a call
ValueError is caught only at tag decode; other exceptions and truthiness failures propagate as in Python
Keys and callback operands/results are released on success, refusal and error after clearing legitimate Python traceback ownership
Exact strings, string subclass partition hooks and actual stored length bounds
No claims decoding before a successful full-width constant-time MAC comparison
Arbitrary-width exact integer limits and unbounded payloads crossing 64 KiB signal blocks

signal_negative_control.method: A bounded subprocess scans a 128 MiB unbounded invalid envelope with a timer signal. Live C argument references are calibrated through a real codec callback; the signal handler must observe the same active-call ownership, excluding delivery only after C returned.
signal_negative_control.negative_control: A scratch copy with PyErr_CheckSignals removed failed the active-call ownership assertion: observed [3], calibrated [4, 4].
signal_negative_control.note: The scratch negative control was never copied into production.

sanitizers.result: passed after correcting isolated subprocess runtime propagation

initial_full_run.reason: macOS dyld removed DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES from the parent process environment; five child workers loaded ASAN too late and aborted with interceptor-startup errors. No C memory-safety finding was reported.

sanitizers.correction: The isolated sitecustomize bootstrap re-exported the same DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES path for child launches; no production source or binary was modified.

mutation_run.note: Isolated ASAN/UBSAN extension and runtime; production binaries untouched

limitations: LeakSanitizer was disabled (detect_leaks=0); object reference and GC ownership were tested separately.
Only this C extension was instrumented; CPython and third-party BLAKE3 were not rebuilt with sanitizers.
Local sanitizer coverage was macOS arm64 with CPython 3.13, not a cross-platform sanitizer certification.
The first full run and corrected subset overlap; their pass counts must not be added as unique tests.

safety_design: Public CPython API and macros only; no private Rust ABI
No new extension module, dependency, cryptographic core or global secret cache
Bound helper retains only fallback/module globals and nonsecret keyword/name objects
Default bounds before slicing, scanning, decoding or hashing
GIL held during classification, with explicit signal checks after every 64 KiB unbounded block
